brief.text: An intricate 18th-century brass orrery on a dark walnut base, with visible interlocking clockwork gears, an animated hand crank, and six revolving planetary spheres (Mercury, Venus, Earth with orbiting Moon, Mars, Jupiter with Galilean moons, and Saturn with rings) orbiting a radiant central Sun.
